title: PolyDiff Image-Family Fact Vector
description: Per-implementation fact vector for the image family. Sibling of fact-vector.schema.json (URL family); both share input_id + parser_profile as the cross-family identity keys that the diff engine pairs vectors on. Axes follow Asemarefactor.md lines 63-77 (canonical Engine 1 image-family schema). When a wrapper binary is absent the wrapper emits a crash envelope with binary_missing=true and decode_outcome.status=crash; that envelope still validates so the missing parser stays auditable in the diff report.

parser_profile.description: Wrapper id (libwebp, libavif, libheif, glide_bitmap, coil_decoder).

binary_missing.description: Set by the wrapper when the underlying native/JVM binary is not on PATH. The remaining axes are then null and decode_outcome.status MUST be 'crash'.

dimensions.description: Decoded image dimensions in pixels. null when the wrapper produced no observable dimension (decode_error / binary_missing).

color_space.description: Color profile name + bit depth as decoded by the implementation. null when not observable.

alpha_premultiplied.description: Whether the implementation reports alpha-premultiplied output.

frame_count.description: Number of frames decoded. >1 for animated WebP/AVIF/HEIF.

first_pixel_rgba.description: RGBA quadruplet of the first decoded pixel (top-left). Pinned cross-impl comparison anchor.

decode_outcome.description: Implementation-reported decode result. status='crash' indicates the wrapper subprocess crashed (segfault, ASAN abort, FileNotFoundError); 'oom' indicates allocation refused; 'decode_error' is a clean rejection by the parser; 'ok' is a clean decode.

parser_warnings.description: Implementation-emitted warnings (libwebp: 'invalid huffman table'; libheif: 'unrecognized box'; etc.). Empty array when the decode is clean.
